nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Mini 10% AHA Lemonade Smoothing Scrub

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the scrub cuts down on oiliness through the day and works well for their T-zone, with one noting it lightened dark spots.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one describing it as 'the driest skin on the planet,' report visible improvement in texture and softness rather than added dryness or flaking.
segments.combination: One reviewer with an oily T-zone and dry outer perimeter reports brighter, smoother skin and easier makeup application.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: most say it did not irritate them and even helped conditions like KP, but a few report burning, redness if left on too long, or that it is 'a little much' for sensitive skin.
segments.mature: A reviewer with maturing 39-year-old skin reports brighter, smoother results and easier makeup application; another reports reduced wrinkles and softer skin with daily use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging concerns report smoother skin, reduced wrinkles, and a firmer, brighter look after regular use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report the scrub left skin soft and improved flaky, dry patches when paired with a moisturizer; no reports of increased dryness.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation or redness, but a couple note their skin got 'a little too red' if the product was left on longer than directed.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports burning and that the product was too harsh for her barrier, while several others with sensitive skin report no reaction at all.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report noticeable lightening or evening out of dark spots and sun spots within weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and improvement in acne or bacne with regular use; however, one reviewer reports over 100 new breakouts after two weeks of use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the scrub leaves skin feeling clean without dryness or excess oil, and one notes reduced oiliness throughout the day.

aspects.libelle: Off or artificial smell in some batches

extraits.texte: This product made my entire face break out. I have been using the same cleanser and toner for a decade and this scrub was the only new product in my lineup. After two weeks of usage, it destroyed my skin and made me break out in more than 100 breakouts. Yes I counted. I cannot believe this product did this to my skin. I think it's too late for a refund, but please save yourself and your skin.

I have a very mixed review on this product for a few different reasons. Starting with the positive, I did like how soft it left my skin after using BUT, having sensitive skin, it did burn while I used it and I thought it would smell better for a facial scrub. Overall, I probably won't use it again because it did really burn my skin. If it was made with gentler ingredients I would consider using it!

I love using this exfoliating scrub! Ive tried other brands (PTR & Dermologica) but the exfoliating particles always felt too small. With the OLEHENRIKSEN scrub the particles are a little larger and I can actually feel the smoothness after! I have maturing 39 yr old skin, with an oily T zone & very dry outer perimeter, with sun spots, and acne. I let the scrub sit for a few minutes while I'm in the shower and will do that every 4 or more days. My skin is brighter, smoother, and it helps my makeup application look flawless as well!
I have extremely sensitive acne prone skin and this product has not broken me out at all! My skin is literally the clearest its been in years and glowing!

extraits.titre: Love this, on my fourth tube...
extraits.texte: I've been using this scrub for a couple years now, probably about once a week since I have pretty sensitive skin and any more would cause problems. I have dry, sensitive skin so once I find something that works and doesn't cause damage to my skin - or hurt - I try to stick with it. I don't really have a problem with pores other than some in the crease between my bottom lip and chin, but this does amazing for my dry skin. I only use it in the summer when the heat isn't on constantly and drying out my skin and making it more sensitive (as opposed to winter), so I go through about a tube per summer (late spring and early fall).
I have the driest skin on the planet and i use this everyday. Noticeable change in texture and wrinkles. And my skin is so soft now. Search no more.

My skin feels amazing, my pores are even smaller. I find myself being less oily throughout the day as well. My skin is looking better than it has for a while overall. My 16 year old daughter is also obsessed.
